stepNotes.1: QuestionRoutes is mounted at /question (server.ts:318) and defines list, reply, and reject operations with distinct OpenAPI operation IDs in question.ts:13-108.
stepNotes.2: Pending prompt contents and deferred settlement cross the HTTP boundary; runtime/password auth and browser-origin enforcement precede routing at server.ts:166-196, while requestID and reply bodies are schema-validated.
stepNotes.3: The reply path validates live question count, trims values, rejects blanks and duplicates, enforces cardinality and option membership, and emits structured 400/404 responses (question.ts:53-74, 121-156).
stepNotes.4: MEDIUM: reply and reject pre-check Question.list then ignore whether the later state mutation applied; concurrent losers can still return 200 or publish duplicate/contradictory events (question.ts:57-105; question/index.ts:231-267).
stepNotes.5: Question.list and each route pre-check are O(p) over an in-memory pending map; answer validation is linear in submitted values and labels, with no external I/O or material scaling concern.
stepNotes.6: HTTP/OpenAPI, branded route parameters, and question state have clear owners, but atomic claim/delete and an applied boolean belong in Question.reply/reject, following permission/index.ts:418-460.
stepNotes.7: LOW: question.ts:111-114 documents a string-or-null return although validateQuestionAnswers actually returns a tagged object at lines 121-156; structured error paths otherwise avoid silent catches.
stepNotes.8: route-validation.test.ts:594-673 covers stale reply and normalized success; reject, list, individual validation failures, and concurrent settlement lack direct route tests. Focused tests passed 43/43 and core typecheck passed.
stepNotes.9: Registered one MEDIUM concurrency defect and two LOW maintenance/coverage gaps; no Critical or High item exists, so the Critical-only reverify artifact is not required before ax-code-glm verification.
